Cors.//: 5173 is Vite's default. 5174 is what Vite falls back to when 5173 is taken, which it is whenever another project in this workspace is running -- POS's back-office is also a Vite app pinned to 5173. Without this second entry the two cannot be run side by side: the browser blocks the login request, and the client reports it as 'wrong email or password' rather than as a network failure. Development only; the base appsettings.json allows nothing.
